about: The epistola of the formulary “18th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: I give thanks to my God always for you, because of the grace of God that was given to you in Christ Jesus: that in all things you have been made rich in Him, in all speech and in all knowledge, as the testimony of Christ has been confirmed in you, so that you lack nothing in any grace, as you await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ, who will also confirm you to the end without blame, on the day of the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
